children: Academy Sports & Outdoors, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with higher revenue and earnings versus the prior-year quarter, driven by strength in outdoor and sports categories and improved margins.
¹ Reported as “Net Sales”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings Per Common Share”.
Revenue growth: Net sales rose 4.7% year-to-date and 3.0% in Q2, led by outdoor and sports & recreation categories.
Channel shift: E-commerce penetration increased to about 11.6% year-to-date (12.1% in Q2); e-commerce sales were up roughly 15% year-over-year.
Store expansion: Opened 21 stores since prior-year Q2, including 3 in Q2; 68 stores opened since 2022 with new stores averaging about $13M trailing twelve months.
Margin and pricing: Gross margin improved materially aided by tariff refunds and pricing actions, with some tariff benefits reinvested into strategic pricing.
Operational investments: Continued spending on omnichannel, fulfillment, IT, customer experience and enhanced inventory tools to support growth.
